# Data
data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 5)

# 1. Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)

ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')

for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(v + 0.3, i, f'${v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=10)

age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()

wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                    colors=colors[:len(age_sales)], explode=[0.05]*len(age_sales))
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Quantity vs Price by Product
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for i, product in enumerate(df['product'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['product'] == product]
    ax3.scatter(subset['price'], subset['quantity'], s=subset['total']*20, 
                label=product, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_xlabel('Unit Price ($)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Quantity')
ax3.set_title('Price vs Quantity (bubble size = total)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(loc='upper right')

# 4. Sales by Time and Size
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['hour'] = df['time'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split(':')[0]))
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='hour', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex([x for x in size_order if x in pivot_data.index])
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax4, cbar_kws={'label': 'Total ($)'})
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax4.set_ylabel('Size')
ax4.set_title('Sales Heatmap: Size vs Time', fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
